title: farsight-impact-tests v1
description: What uses the changed code, by distance, and which tests a CI job can run for it — with the reasons it must not trust the list. Prose contract: docs/contracts/farsight-impact-tests-v1.md. v1 may gain optional fields and new enum members; nothing listed here changes meaning or goes away without a version bump. The document never carries a total across hops: the single number is what this design exists to replace.

seeds.description: What the question was asked about: a node that was named, or a changed file range that resolved to one.

hops.description: One entry per distance, nearest first. A node listed here is at its NEAREST hop across every seed. There is deliberately no total.

select.description: Tests a job can name and run, one key per runner seen (`vitest`, `playwright`, …). A runner this graph holds none of has no key — an absent key is not an empty suite. This list is a FLOOR whenever `bound` is `floor`.

unselectable.description: Seeds and their DIRECT dependents that yield no test a job could name and run. `unselectable | length == 0` is the CI gate.

fallback.description: `run-all` when the selection cannot be trusted to be complete, otherwise null. Never implied and never omitted.

fallback_reason.description: The sentence behind `fallback`, so a job can say why it ran everything. Null exactly when `fallback` is null.

excluded.description: Reached only across an edge the walk does not cross: the boot (`setup`) and work that runs later on its own (`deferred`). Named apart, never summed into a hop.

cut.description: Where the walk stopped, by reason. What the reader has not seen is part of the answer.

bound.description: `floor` whenever anything was cut, capped, unstamped or resolved at run time — which on today's graphs is always. Same vocabulary as a MetricValue's bound.

identity.description: The `farsight-tests-matrix v1` identity block, verbatim: what the document was computed from.

sync.description: Snapshot ordinal of the graph, when a snapshot store recorded one.

source_commit.description: Workspace commit at snapshot time, when known.

source_digest.description: repo name → content digest of that repo's checkout. Empty when the graph records none.

farsight.description: The build that produced the document (`buildLine()`).

generated_at.description: ISO timestamp. The only field that changes between two runs over the same graph.

from.description: `hunk` means a changed file range resolved to this node — file-and-line granularity, with H4's caveat: the commits that touched a file are not the commits that changed a function.

hop.description: 1 = uses it directly. 2+ = reaches it through something else — a path, not a prediction.

file.description: `''` when the node has no source location (a route that is declared and not built).

edge.description: The edge that reached this node. `technique`/`confidence` are null when the adapter recorded none — an absence of provenance about the edge, never a confidence level.

one_of.description: The call site resolves to several implementations and the code chooses at run time. Null when it does not.

strength.description: How well the path is known: the weakest tier RECORDED on it, and how many of its edges recorded nothing. A pair, never one ladder — `tier: null` with `unstamped: 2` is not a low confidence, it is an absence of provenance.

line.description: Null for a run-level node: a coverage report has no line.

run_level.description: The edge came from a coverage report with no per-test attribution: the run reached it, no single test did.

reason.description: Closed. `no covers edge` = nothing claims, reaches or observed it. `declared only` = a route declared in a spec and not built, so nothing runs it. `inactive` = every covering case is .skip/.todo. `run-level only` = only a whole-run coverage report reached it, and a report cannot name a case to re-run.

`hops` = the budget ended here. `shared` = plumbing or a rendered primitive, not opened. `setup` = the boot, which is not a dependent. `deferred` = work that runs later on its own. `cap` = more dependents at this hop than the answer lists.

node.description: Absent for `cap`, which is a fact about a hop and not about any one node.

behind.description: Everything upstream of this stop the document does not list. NEVER add two of these: the sets overlap.

direct.description: The first ring only: unlisted nodes one edge behind this stop.

edgeKind.description: The verb of the dependency, from the graph. The surface prints this verb and never promotes it to one of consequence.

tier.description: A recorded confidence, or null when the adapter recorded none.

evidenceClass.description: The printed vocabulary: the graph stores `static` and every consumer reads `reached`. A claim is never rendered as an observation.
